recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow source correction to the existing FHIR-32015 application, fixes a broken built-page link and malformed HTML, and does not reopen separate $document operation-definition decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-32015 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to replace wording that implied operation Bundle responses were collection except for search-like responses, because operations such as Composition $document can return a document Bundle.
initial_application: Git commit 5d7c5faef3 applied FHIR-32015 by changing source/operations.html to say Bundle.type is typically collection but may be another type. That application left the example with a typo, an unclosed paging anchor, and a broken/mis-spelled search-set code link.
additional_context: source/operations.html is in the current build scope via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-32015 as 'Will fix' with a 7-0-0 vote, and the originating Zulip thread confirms the scope was the general operations wording around operation-returned Bundles. Later $document-specific issues such as FHIR-19974, FHIR-32016, and FHIR-36699 are related background but govern separate Composition OperationDefinition details.
reconciliation: Changed only source/operations.html: fixed 'For eample' to 'For example', closed the page-links anchor before the comma, changed the example from the broken search-set link/code to the actual searchset Bundle.type code, and retained the approved 'typically collection, but other types are possible' rule.
source_changes: source/operations.html: corrected the FHIR-32015 Bundle.type example typo, closed the paging link, and linked/displayed the actual searchset Bundle.type code.

related_jiras.note: Same originating Zulip thread and $document example, but it concerns the Composition $document output parameter rather than the operations framework Bundle.type paragraph.
Later published $document clarification already represented on the combined branch; it concerns Composition $document wording, not the operations framework paragraph fixed here.
Later no-change/question issue about $document search behavior that was answered through FHIR-19974.
